title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to design, construct, install, test, and maintain robust data management systems. You will be responsible for building scalable data pipelines and infrastructures that collect, process, and transform large datasets into usable information for data scientists and analysts.

Key Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development (ETL/ELT): Design, build, and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using modern data stack tools.

Infrastructure: Construct, manage, and monitor cloud-based data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or Google BigQuery).

Data Modeling: Implement efficient relational and non-relational data models (e.g., Dimensional Modeling, 3NF) for optimal query performance.

Coding & Automation: Write, test, and maintain robust code primarily in Python (Pandas, NumPy) and SQL for data integration and processing tasks.

Workflow Orchestration: Utilize workflow management tools like Apache Airflow or Dagster to schedule and monitor complex pipelines.

Big Data & Streaming: Experience with distributed systems and frameworks such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, or real-time streaming technologies like Kafka is highly desirable.

Quality & Governance: Implement data validation and quality checks to ensure data integrity and reliability across all pipelines.

Requirements & Qualifications:

Education: BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

Experience: Proven experience (3+ years) as a Data Engineer, Software Engineer, or related role focused on data infrastructure.

Core Technical Skills:

Expertise in SQL (writing complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning).

Strong proficiency in Python for scripting, data transformation, and ETL processes.

Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

Preferred (Bonus Skills):

Experience with CI/CD processes (Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

Knowledge of Data Lake concepts (S3, ADLS).

Exposure to NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra).
